scenes.setting: The coffee shop again: the bounty is on Mr. Azik himself — the Numinous Episcopate, or Ince Zangwill steering some faction through 0-08; Old Kohler is set to find out who posted it and taught a few Nighthawk conversation tricks before heading for the docks
scenes.text_anchor: It really is Mr. Azik, not someone sharing the same name…

scenes.setting: Isengard Stanton's house on the servants' improbable day off: blood, scorch marks and no body in the activity room beside 'The Devil's Legend of Sivellaus Borough'; a killer's gaze pins Klein in place while the assistant accuses him and falls apart into a dismembered corpse — until the police burst in and the gaze vanishes

Chained to a water pipe at Chissak Police Station with an unsurprised Jurgen at his side: the letters will be fetched from Minsk Street — and mid-answer a theory lands, that the Devil dog's hidden master has begun avenging himself on those who took the serial-murder bounty
scenes.text_anchor: “I won’t say anything until I see my lawyer.”
